label: Сначала
description: A 10-sentence usage card for сначала (at first, first of all, from the start).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First step in order. 'Сначала' marks the opening action in a sequence, paired with 'потом'. It tells the listener which thing must happen before the rest.
Strategic focus: Initial state changing. 'Сначала' contrasts an early condition with a later one. Here it sets up the impersonal predicate 'трудно' against the later 'легче'.
Strategic focus: From the very beginning. In the set phrase 'начать сначала', the adverb means to start over from the start. It modifies 'начнём' and is extremely common in speech.
Strategic focus: Asking the first step. In a question 'сначала' asks which action comes first. It modifies the future verb 'сделаем' and sits at the end here.
Strategic focus: Priority instruction. 'Сначала' fronts an imperative to stress what should be done before anything else. It modifies 'прочитай' with a clear ordering force.
Strategic focus: Initial reaction. 'Сначала' marks a first attitude that later changed, modifying 'не поверил'. It implies an unstated reversal of belief over time.
Strategic focus: Think before acting. 'Сначала' fronts the imperative 'подумай', urging reflection as the first step. The register is neutral and works as everyday advice.
Strategic focus: Early impression. 'Сначала' sets up a first feeling with the dative experiencer 'мне', modifying 'нравилось'. It hints that the impression shifted afterwards.
Strategic focus: Repeat from the start. Here 'сначала' means from the beginning again, modifying the imperative 'объясни'. It asks the speaker to restart the whole explanation.
Strategic focus: Natural ordering. 'Сначала' opens a two-part sequence answered by 'затем'. It frames winter as coming first before spring follows.
